data.name: Bonus Feat
data.description: At 3rd level, a student of perfection gains one feat based on his chosen House of Perfection. At 7th level, he gains another such feat. A student of perfection need not meet the prerequisites normally required for these feats. Alternatively, if the student of perfection has levels in a class that grants bonus feats, he can instead choose one of those bonus feats, adding his student of perfection level to his level in that class to determine available feats.[NOTE:SOME ARCHETYPES MAY REQUIRE MANUAL INPUT DUE TO SPECIALIZED BONUS FEAT LISTS!]
